full_judgment: 10. The said writ petitions were heard analogously and those Rules were discharged on 12-6-2012 with observations that the writ petitioners are at liberty to invoke the proper forum as provided under Section 145A of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. As per the said observations, the petitioners (except in writ petition Nos.2581/2014 and 2580/2014) filed Land Survey Suit Nos. 8 of 2013, 15/2013, 14/2013, 10/2013, 11/2013, 13/2013, 16/2013, 18/2013 and before the Land Survey Tribunal Dhaka Mohanagor which is still pending.
